author: (H. C. Lea, 1845)

note.en: A slender needle-shaped snail about 1 cm long that lives in seagrass and algae; known here from museum specimens.
note.es: Un caracol delgado en forma de aguja, de cerca de 1 cm, que vive en pasto marino y algas; conocido aquí por ejemplares de museo.

evidence: GBIF: 5 records in the region (specimens and observations)
recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 5 records in the region (specimens and observations).

marks.en: Tall, narrow tower-shaped shell with spiral cords running around each whorl; brown.
marks.es: Concha alta y estrecha en forma de torre, con cordones espirales en cada vuelta; parda.
